description: This file defines the OpenAIResponsesAPIConfig class, which implements methods for transforming, validating, and handling responses and requests to and from the OpenAI Responses API within a larger AI/ML project. It includes methods for request/response transformation, streaming, error handling, and environment validation.

classes.name: OpenAIResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that provides methods for transforming requests and responses, environment validation, and streaming handling specific to OpenAI's Responses API.

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the provider type, which is OPENAI in this configuration.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI API parameters.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, response_api_optional_params: ResponsesAPIOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps API parameters without changes as inputs are already in OpenAI format.

methods.name: Dict transform_responses_api_request( self, model: str, input: Union[str, ResponseInputParam], response_api_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms request parameters into the API call format, ensuring input validation.

methods.name: Union[str,ResponseInputParam] _validate_input_param( self, input: Union[str, ResponseInputParam] )
methods.description: Validates and converts the input parameter, handling pydantic models and reasoning items.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _handle_reasoning_item(self, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Filters None values from reasoning items, creating ResponseReasoningItem objects.

methods.name: ResponsesAPIResponse transform_response_api_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Processes the raw API response, adjusts timestamps, and constructs a ResponsesAPIResponse object.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Ensures proper API key headers are set.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for responses endpoint.

methods.name: ResponsesAPIStreamingResponse transform_streaming_response( self, model: str, parsed_chunk: dict, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Converts a streaming response chunk into a typed event object.

methods.name: Any get_event_model_class(event_type: str)
methods.description: Returns the appropriate event class based on the event type string.

methods.name: bool should_fake_stream( self, model: Optional[str], stream: Optional[bool], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Determines if streaming should be faked based on model support and stream flag.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_delete_response_api_request( self, response_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Creates URL and data for delete response API call.

methods.name: DeleteResponseResult transform_delete_response_api_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms delete API response into a DeleteResponseResult object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_response_api_request( self, response_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Creates URL and data for get response API call.

methods.name: ResponsesAPIResponse transform_get_response_api_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms get API response into a ResponsesAPIResponse object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_list_input_items_request( self, response_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, after: Optional[str] = None, before: Optional[str] = None, include: Optional[List[str]] = None, limit: int = 20, order: Literal["asc", "desc"] = "desc", )
methods.description: Creates URL and parameters for listing input items.

methods.name: Dict transform_list_input_items_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Processes the response for listing input items.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_cancel_response_api_request( self, response_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Creates URL and data for cancel response API call.

methods.name: ResponsesAPIResponse transform_cancel_response_api_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms cancel API response into a ResponsesAPIResponse object.
